Reverse base-plus-rate formula, including a stated whole-income percentage relationship.
Divide total tax by whole taxable income and multiply100.
Calculate tax at a boundary for base tax, or reverse an excess to find the missing rate.
Find tax at both incomes across a boundary and subtract, distinguishing extra from total tax.
